name: Armored Horseman (Combat)
body:
Many hours in the saddle, combined with your physical strength, allow you to more easily wear armor when on horseback.

Prerequisite: Str 13, 5 ranks in Ride.

Benefit: You may reduce your armor check penalty by an amount equal to your Strength bonus when making a Ride check. You may not reduce your armor check penalty to less than 0 through the use of this feat.
